label: SI cross-asset US opening-range reversal into the close (December filter) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `6N US opening-range reversal into the close (December filter)`. Session-window return predicts a later same-day session return. Filtered by signalMonth=12. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.83 over 58 trades; average planned RR 4.98, min planned RR 4.83; bootstrap p05 1.57, block-bootstrap p05 1.66, annual pass rate 100%.
